title: Operator-norm Sudakov minoration for Gaussian chaos of order two
summary: We prove that an operator-norm separated family of matrices satisfies $\mathbb{E}\sup_{A\in T} G^{T}AG' \geq ca\log |T|$, where G,G' are independent standard Gaussian vectors and a is the separation. The main information estimate concerns arbitrary separated coisometries: conditional entropy is bounded by a source-dependent operator energy times $\log|T|$, up to an additive quadratic term in the common row dimension.
